description_en: Starts a successfully created outbound call task for the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service chatbot
description_zh: 启动已创建成功的智能联络机器人呼叫任务
name: StartTask

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the chatbot outbound call task. You can view the ID on the Task Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) page or obtain it by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID。在任务管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)页面查看或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html接口获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to start the task immediately. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No. The task is not started
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即启动。取值：
true：是。
false：否。代表不启动任务
parameters.name: start_now

Code.description_en: The status code of the request. A value of OK indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Data.description_zh:
是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call is successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
